name: sereus-erp
description: WyattERP on Sereus. Workspace root for packages/* and the headless apps; see README.md.

scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological --exclude sereus-erp run build
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological --exclude sereus-erp run test
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological --exclude sereus-erp run typecheck
